Overview

Windsor is a city in Ontario with a population of 229,000. Canada’s southernmost city, a border city across from Detroit known for its automotive industry, the Windsor Riverfront, and Casino Windsor. Housing is more affordable than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees.
